invariants.rationale: The method assumes element is not null for nearly all operations and it is not re-assigned to null inside the method.
If element has the key 'firstgid', then getString("firstgid") should not be null, per guard condition at entry.
If 'image' key is present, imageSource is set using getString("image").
tmjFile is used as a FileHandle for various operations and not changed.
imageResolver is passed through to tile loader calls and assumed non-null for safe operation.
